name: v1.0.2
body:
### zapret2 v1.0.2

Prebuilt zapret2 (nfqws2) packages for OpenWrt, repackaged from
[bol-van/zapret2](https://github.com/bol-van/zapret2) static binaries.

Check your device architecture:
```
. /etc/openwrt_release && echo "$DISTRIB_ARCH"
```

Install the matching `zapret2_*` package (`.apk` on apk systems,
`.ipk` on opkg) plus the noarch `luci-app-zapret2` for the LuCI UI.
